stem: Four students with number cards want to line up from left to right in order from least to greatest number.

options.label: A
options.text: Olivia should be between Erin and Rico.

options.label: B
options.text: Erin should be on the right end after Olivia.

options.label: C
options.text: Penelope should be on the right end after Olivia.

options.label: D
options.text: All the students are in the correct order.

visual_elements: Four students holding cards: Erin with 9,975, Rico with 90,096, Penelope with 98,300, Olivia with 98,087, arranged left to right in that order.
difficulty_rationale: Requires comparing and ordering multi-digit numbers and evaluating the correctness of a provided sequence.
